$comment: Single source of truth for scripts/check-cwv.mjs. The gate reads this file; it
does not restate any number. Change a budget here, or a route list here, and the
PROVENANCE. Section 3.2 of hydroma-nojin-master-plan.md states exactly one
performance budget: 200 kB of initial JavaScript on a public page. It states no
time budget at all. The four time budgets below are therefore NOT the plan's.
They are the web.dev Core Web Vitals 'good' thresholds, imported here so the
plan's binding criterion can be given a number at all, and they are labelled as
imported everywhere they are printed. If the plan later states its own numbers,
replace this block and nothing else needs to change.
INP is a field metric. No lab run measures it and this gate does not pretend
to. `inp` is declared as a field budget and is deliberately NOT asserted; what
the gate asserts in its place is Total Blocking Time, Lighthouse's lab proxy,
against `tbtProxyBudgetMs`. Reporting TBT as INP would be a fabricated claim.

provenance.javascriptTransferBytes: hydroma-nojin-master-plan.md §3.2 — 200 kB, the plan's own budget
provenance.lcpMs: imported: web.dev Core Web Vitals 'good' threshold, 2500 ms
provenance.cls: imported: web.dev Core Web Vitals 'good' threshold, 0.1
provenance.tbtProxyBudgetMs: imported: web.dev 'good' INP threshold, applied to the lab proxy TBT
provenance.inpMs: field only; not assertable in a lab run

fieldBudgetsNotAsserted.why: INP requires real user interaction across real sessions. The collection endpoint is app/api/observability/web-vitals; turning that stream into an assertion needs production traffic.

routes.role: heaviest public page by First Load JS
routes.buildEvidence: next build 2026-09-29: /[locale]/auth/login  3.59 kB  First Load JS 170 kB — the heaviest in the 356-route table, tied with /[locale]/auth/signup (170 kB).

routes.role: server-rendered content page from a gateway contract
routes.buildEvidence: next build 2026-09-29: /[locale]/market/products  4.79 kB  First Load JS 160 kB. The apiGet/DataStateCard shape is the majority of the app; this is one instance of it.

next build 2026-09-29: /[locale]/learn/content/search  4.79 kB  First Load JS 160 kB. Renders components/surface/NoJsSearch.tsx, a real <form method="get" action=""> — a form that works with JS disabled is a claim, so it is measured.

routes.role: the MapLibre island — §3.3 says the bytes are lazy, so the initial weight is the claim under test
routes.buildEvidence: next build 2026-09-29: /[locale]/market/bazaars/[id]/map  2.78 kB  First Load JS 119 kB, 41 kB BELOW the 160 kB that ordinary content pages cost. The map is the route where §3.3 claims the bytes are lazy-loaded.

routes.role: the offline route — a state most likely to be neglected
routes.buildEvidence: next build 2026-09-29: /[locale]/offline  298 B  First Load JS 120 kB.

routes.expectStatusNote: Measured on 2026-09-29: this route answers HTTP 200 with <meta name="robots" content="index, follow">, 115,248 bytes and no <h1>. 200 is recorded here because it is what the server does today; the gate must not fail on the current behaviour, and must fail loudly the moment the route is fixed to return 404. Change this field to 404 at the same time as fixing the route.
routes.buildEvidence: next build 2026-09-29: /[locale]/[...slug]  724 B  First Load JS 120 kB, and the root /_not-found at 105 kB.
